plan.title: The Seat at the Counter
plan.scene: a port tavern at night. the counter runs along one wall. behind it, shelves of bottles catch the lamplight. three stools face the counter. the door opens onto the dark harbor.
plan.turn: Le_pirate tells justin the hearing is tomorrow at sunrise and asks him to come early to walk to the courthouse together.

needs.text: James disappeared three years ago without explanation.
Le_pirate believes James stole cargo and ran away that night.
Justin has always dreamed of owning a ship and commanding it himself.
Le_pirate is Justin's only path to owning that ship.

infos.text: James disappeared three years ago without explanation.
Le_pirate believes James stole cargo and ran away that night.
Justin has always dreamed of owning a ship and commanding it himself, not working for others.
Le_pirate is Justin's only path to owning that ship.
If Justin testifies that James stole the cargo, James will be destroyed.
Lily cares deeply whether James is declared guilty or innocent.
Did James run because he was guilty, or for another reason?

beats.what: Le_pirate leans forward on his stool, energized by the sight of Justin entering; Lily, sitting three stools away, stiffens slightly and looks down at her drink.
Le_pirate and Justin recall aloud the night they first met at this counter, each remembering a different detail that makes them laugh; Lily, still present, says nothing but watches Justin laugh.
Justin says aloud to Le_pirate that he wants to own a ship one day and sail it himself, not pour drinks for someone else forever, but admits he does not know how that will ever happen.

Le_pirate responds that Justin has always said that, then tells Justin he knows how to make it happen; that is why he kept Justin's seat at the counter for three years, even when Justin did not show up.
Le_pirate asks Justin aloud where James went that night three years ago; Justin says he does not know; Le_pirate says James ran because he was guilty of stealing the cargo.
Le_pirate tells Justin that tomorrow at the harbor court hearing, he needs Justin to testify that he saw James loading stolen goods onto the ship the night before James vanished.
Lily stands from her stool and tells Justin that if he testifies, he will be confirming that James was a thief; she says she is against it, then leaves the bar area.

beats.tech: Menace : si tu X, je Y
beats.what: Le_pirate tells Justin that if he testifies, the partnership becomes real and the path to owning a ship opens; if he does not, Le_pirate will have to walk away from him.
Justin must choose now: promise Le_pirate he will testify tomorrow, or ask for time to think.
opts: Promise Le_pirate you will testify tomorrow. The partnership opens, the ship becomes possible. But Lily will see you as the man who destroyed James.
Tell Le_pirate you need time to remember what you saw that night. You stay between them both, but Le_pirate's trust thins and the ship moves further away.

beats.what: Justin tells Le_pirate he will testify, then tells Lily he cannot possibly do it because he was too drunk that night to remember anything clearly.
Le_pirate arrives at the tavern before dawn to walk to the courthouse; he overhears Lily telling Justin she loves him for choosing not to testify.
Le_pirate leaves without a word; by the time Justin follows him outside, the ship's crew is already untying the lines and Le_pirate is leaving the harbor.
